mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a documented Momersion(10,20) crossing its neutral 50 boundary identifies a switch between momentum and mean-reversion in consecutive four-hour close changes; on the switch bar, follow its close change when momentum becomes dominant and fade it when mean reversion becomes dominant for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: on a strict crossing above 50, use the sign of current close minus prior close; on a strict crossing below 50, use the opposite sign; require a strict nonzero current change
mechanism.why_distinct: Momersion counts whether consecutive close changes share a sign or alternate signs, using up to twenty products and a ten-product readiness floor. It is not magnitude momentum, autocorrelation, a moving average, channel, range path, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the regime switch distinguishes continuation from alternation while completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation ranks in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse sign-product regime boundary switches with conditional follow/fade direction are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.change: current completed close minus immediately prior completed close
features.product: current change times immediately prior change
features.momersion: 100 times positive nonzero products divided by all nonzero products in the latest up-to-20 product window once at least 10 products exist; official zero-density fallback 50
features.event: strict finite crossing from <=50 to >50 follows current change sign; strict crossing from >=50 to <50 takes the opposite; current change zero gives no event
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: close, product window, readiness, and crossing state reset after any invalid completed four-hour bar

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official LEAN Momersion(10,20) neutral regime switch under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no periods, neutral level, product treatment, switch direction, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Michael Harris Momersion Indicator; QuantConnect LEAN canonical implementation
external_basis.fixed_definition: documented minPeriod=10 and fullPeriod=20; each observation is (C_t-C_t-1)*(C_t-1-C_t-2); mc counts positive products and mRc negative products; Momersion=100*mc/(mc+mRc), returning 50 when not ready or when zero products are at least half; warmup 12 closes
external_basis.neutral_interpretation: above 50 means momentum sign persistence dominates; below 50 means mean-reverting sign alternation dominates
external_basis.selection_use: official documented periods, product signs, 50 neutral boundary, and published momentum-versus-mean-reversion interpretation only; no incidence or outcomes
